# MacroGrace Intros

> Intros that turn any static site into a presentation. Open-source agent skills, MIT licensed.

Install for any agent: `npx skills add MD412/macrograce-intros`

Install for Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add MD412/macrograce-intros`, then `/plugin install intros-root@macrograce-intros` and `/plugin install build-intro-agentic@macrograce-intros`

## Intros

- [Agentic build](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MD412/macrograce-intros/main/skills/build-intro-agentic/SKILL.md): Available. A start screen, a scan of the real layout, then labeled cursor agents build the actual page. [Live demo](https://dandoy-me.vercel.app/?build=1)
- Blueprint: Coming soon
- Typeset: Coming soon
- Develop: Coming soon
- Guided tour: Coming soon
- Terminal boot: Coming soon

## Skills

- [intros-root](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MD412/macrograce-intros/main/skills/intros-root/SKILL.md): Inspects a static site and picks an intro
